text: E1 autonomous checkpoint: the 0T gate map (run 0, ~37x105) should be near row ~10. Read the hera-watch background output (task bxsa47acy) and the latest data/0 digest. Decide continue / re-center / abort per the proposing cell's checkpoint fork: (a) Rxx ridge visible and traversing within the TG window -> continue; (b) ridge pinned at TG edge every row -> abort & re-center; (c) BG/Si leakage approaching 1nA -> interrupt (nb-collab interrupt) immediately and notify. Then resume driving the investigation ladder.

E1 autonomous: run-0 gate map should be complete (or check why not). If complete: run hera_scratch/cnp_fit.py on the full data/0, make raw Rxx(TG,BG) maps + fitted-ridge overlays per channel (sr1,sr2), promote to the ana notebook (raw first, then fit), record the (n,D) calibration (c_bg/c_tg ratio, intercept, n_offset, D=0 line design) + cross-channel agreement, then drive into trilayer-stacking-fs-count Step 2 (F_L feasibility) and Step 3 (sdh-spot-check). Record calibration in session_notes for device-card write-back. If run-0 hung or interrupted: read data/0 metadata + hera-watch task bxsa47acy, diagnose, and recover.

E1 autonomous checkpoint: hole SdH spot check (run 1, n=-3.4e12 D=0, B 0.1->2T uniform-1/B, ~1003 pts, ~62min) at ~20 min (~B 0.14T). Read hera-watch (task b5nfxsxlx) + execute-cell (task bieaieico) output. Verify: (a) cell setup printed clean (no overload abort; sensitivity table sane); (b) Rxx channels (sr1,sr2) un-railed and not climbing toward full-scale as B grows; (c) BG/Si leakage <1nA; (d) rate on track. Continue if healthy; nb-collab interrupt if a channel rails or leakage climbs. At completion: re-form Rxx(B) from the TSV, run hera.analysis.sdh_onset + sdh_fft per Rxx channel, read tone content vs F_L=35.2T (one tone=ABC, pair summing to F_L=ABA), promote raw+FFT to ana notebook, then launch the ELECTRON spot check (n=+3.4e12, sweep field 2->0.1T down, no re-traverse). Then decide Step 4 fan side/range.

E1 autonomous checkpoint: high-field hole SdH sweep (run 2, B 2->8T, 81 pts, ~48min) at ~20 min (~B 4.5-5T). Read hera-watch (task b0aucmb86) + cell-36 setup stdout. Verify: SdH oscillations emerging above MR (look at sr1/sr2 R hi-lo spread growing = oscillation amplitude), channels un-railed (sr1/sr2 < full-scale at the growing Rxx), leakage <1nA, rate sane. Continue to 8T regardless (max field). At completion: stitch run1(0.1-2T)+run2(2-8T) Rxx(B), re-run FFT over the full 0.1-8T uniform-1/B record per Rxx channel, read tones vs F_L=35.2T (one tone=ABC, pair summing to F_L=ABA; screen harmonics; pin scale to whole peak set). Promote to ana. Then: if tones resolved -> design Step 4 high-field fan (hole side, B to 8T) and/or electron spot check at high field; if still unresolved at 8T -> draft the resolution-limited (Step 7) assessment (onset/mobility/T_e numbers, what would change it) and surface to operator. Update session_notes. If run 2 interrupted/railed: read data/2 metadata + hera-watch b0aucmb86, diagnose, recover.

E1 autonomous: high-field hole sweep (run 2, 2->8T) should be complete. Run hera_scratch/sdh_stitch.py 35.2 1.0 7.2 (stitches run1+run2 -> 0.1-8T, masks railed points, FFTs the oscillating window per Rxx channel). View hera_scratch/sdh_stitch.png — read the ΔRxx vs 1/B oscillation traces AND the FFT tones vs F_L=35.2T (one tone=ABC, pair summing to F_L=ABA; screen harmonics; pin scale to whole peak set). Try a couple of FFT windows (e.g. 1.3-8, 2-7) for stability (real peaks sharpen, artifacts wander). Promote raw+osc+FFT to ana with the read. Then: tones resolved -> design Step 4 high-field fan (hole side, B to 8T, inherit this dwell/sampling) + decide if an electron high-field spot check is needed; still unresolved at 8T -> draft the resolution-limited Step 7 assessment (onset ~1.3T, T_e~8K, mobility estimate, what would change it: lower-T rig). Update session_notes. Note magnet is left at 8T - plan the next field move (fan can start at 8T and sweep down). If run 2 interrupted/railed badly: read data/2 metadata + hera-watch b0aucmb86, diagnose, recover.

E1 autonomous checkpoint: Landau fan (run 3, 65×31, B 8->1.4T, ~1.8h) at ~17 min. Read hera-watch (task b40g2u1w4) + cell-38 setup table. The first slow rows are at high B (8T) sweeping n -3.5..-1.5e12 incl the worst corner (low-|n|×8T). Verify: sr1/sr2 un-railed across the full n-sweep at 8T (R hi < ~4.5kΩ rail at sens 1e-4/20nA), leakage BG/Si <1nA, rate sane, no flat/NaN columns. Continue if healthy; nb-collab interrupt + resize sens if railing. At completion: load run 3 via fan_grids+resistance_grids, FFT each n-column (uniform-1/B) per Rxx channel -> F(n); test the Luttinger partition Sum f(n)=F_L(n)=(h/4e)*n algebraically across density (decisive: ABA pair sums to F_L, ABC singleton sits at F_L, mixed = both); screen harmonics; read sr1 vs sr2 separately (per-region). Overlay on the Onsager forward model (hera/models/trilayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py, valid |n|<=3.5e12) for ML/BL labeling. Promote raw fan + per-column FFT + F(n) to ana with a STYLE strength verdict per channel. Then move toward the Step 7 output contract (per-region call). Update session_notes. Fan ends at 1.4T. If interrupted/railed: read data/3 metadata + hera-watch b40g2u1w4, diagnose, recover.

E1 autonomous: check the Landau fan (run 3). If complete: run hera_scratch/fan_analyze.py (per-column SdH-FFT -> F(n), Luttinger partition Sum f(n)=F_L(n), waterfall), debug it on real data, view hera_scratch/fan_analyze.png. EXCLUDE the clipped low-|n| columns (n>-1.9e12 rail at B>6.5T, sens 1e-4) — already masked by the |X|>0.88*sens guard. Read per channel (sr1,sr2 separately): does the dominant tone sit AT F_L(n) across density (ABC singleton) or do TWO tones sum to F_L(n) (ABA pair)? Screen harmonics (integer multiples). Overlay the Onsager model: cd hera/models/trilayer_fs_count; the functions aba_fs(n,U)/abc_fs(n,ud) give ML/BL vs single-pocket F(n) (valid |n|<=3.5e12) for labeling. Promote raw fan + F(n) + partition + overlay to ana with a per-region STYLE strength verdict (decisive/strong/weak/consistent-with/uninformative). Then assemble the Step 7 output contract: per-region call (ABA/ABC/mixed/uninformative), evidence list, confidence+hedges, what would firm it. Update session_notes. Magnet ends at 1.4T. If still running: re-read progress + leakage, reschedule. If interrupted: data/3 metadata + hera-watch b40g2u1w4, diagnose.

E1 autonomous: check the Landau fan (run 3). If complete: run hera_scratch/fan_analyze.py on full data, view hera_scratch/fan_analyze.png. The DECISIVE read (full-resolution per channel, clipped low-|n| columns auto-excluded): (1) fit F_dom(n) -> ratio alpha to F_L (partial data showed ~0.54); (2) HARMONIC SCREEN - is the ~F_L feature a 2x harmonic of the ~0.5 F_L dominant tone (power at 2*F_dom, tracks 2x across n) or an independent pocket tracking F_L(n)? a real pocket's harmonic tracks k*f exactly; (3) Luttinger: do the genuine (non-harmonic) tones sum to F_L(n) across density (ABA pair) or does one sit at F_L (ABC singleton)? (4) Onsager overlay: cd hera/models/trilayer_fs_count; aba_fs(n,U) returns ML+BL pocket freqs, abc_fs(n,ud) the single-pocket freq (valid |n|<=3.5e12) - overlay measured F(n) with a single global density rescale (0.8-1.2 plausible) to LABEL the tone(s) as ML/BL vs single. Read sr1 vs sr2 separately. Promote raw fan + F(n) + harmonic screen + Luttinger + Onsager overlay to ana with a per-region STYLE strength verdict. Then assemble the Step 7 output contract (per-region call, evidence list, confidence+hedges, what would firm it, cannot-tell-is-valid). Update session_notes. Magnet ends at 1.4T - plan: park to 0 when done OR hold for a confirming measurement. If still running: re-read progress+leakage, reschedule. If interrupted: data/3 metadata + hera-watch b40g2u1w4.
